guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: Learn how to use congdongvang.com to manage your finances and investments effectively.

homepage.title: Dashboard Homepage
homepage.description: The dashboard homepage gives you a complete overview of your financial situation — from net worth and wallet balances to live market prices and investment PNL tracking.

netWorth.title: Net Worth
netWorth.description: The net worth card at the top of the page shows the total value of all your wallets converted to a single currency. This figure updates automatically whenever you add or modify a transaction.
netWorth.tip: Click the net worth card to see a detailed breakdown by wallet and asset category.

wallets.title: Wallet Management
wallets.description: Wallets are the basic unit for organizing your assets. You can create multiple wallets for different purposes: cash, bank accounts, investment portfolios, and more.

createWallet.title: Creating a New Wallet
steps: Click the '+' or 'Add Wallet' button on the Wallets page.
Enter a name for the wallet and set the initial balance.
Choose a currency (VND, USD, EUR, ...).
Click 'Save' to create the wallet.

transferMoney.title: Transferring Money Between Wallets
steps: On the Wallets page, click the 'Transfer Money' button.
Select the source wallet and destination wallet.
Enter the amount to transfer.
The system automatically creates two offsetting transactions to maintain balance totals.
Click 'Confirm' to complete the transfer.

wallets.tip: Consider creating a separate INVESTMENT wallet for each asset group (stocks, gold) to track the performance of each group independently.

priceTables.title: Market Price Tables
priceTables.description: The homepage displays gold, silver, and currency price tables automatically updated from trusted sources (SJC, DOJI, PNJ, Vietcombank...). Prices refresh every 15 minutes.
priceTables.goldTable: The gold price table shows buy/sell prices for each gold type (SJC, DOJI, PNJ...) in thousands of VND per tael.
priceTables.silverTable: The silver price table shows buy/sell prices in thousands of VND per tael.
priceTables.currencyTable: The currency table shows USD, EUR, and other exchange rates from the free market and Vietcombank.
priceTables.staleIndicator: Prices display '--' when a data source is temporarily unavailable. The system restores data automatically when the source comes back online.
priceTables.tip: Click the 'Gold', 'Silver', or 'Currency' tabs to switch between price tables.

pnlTracking.title: PNL Tracking (Profit & Loss)
pnlTracking.description: The PNL card on the homepage shows the total unrealized profit/loss of your entire investment portfolio in real time.
pnlTracking.unrealized: Unrealized PNL is the difference between the current market price and the average cost basis of the investments you are currently holding.
pnlTracking.realized: Realized PNL is the profit or loss locked in when you sell part or all of an investment.
pnlTracking.tip: Green color indicates a gain, red indicates a loss relative to your cost basis.

investment.title: Investment Portfolio
investment.description: The Portfolio page lets you track all your investments in a unified interface — stocks, ETFs, cryptocurrency, gold, silver, and custom assets.

addingInvestments.title: Adding Investments
addingInvestments.description: To add an investment, you need at least one INVESTMENT-type wallet.
steps: Select an investment wallet from the wallet list.
Click the 'Add Investment' button or the '+' icon.
Search for a ticker symbol (e.g. VCB, BTC-USD, AAPL) or enter details manually.
Fill in the quantity, purchase price, and transaction date.
Click 'Save' to record the investment.

symbolSearch.title: Symbol Search
symbolSearch.description: Type at least 2 characters in the search box and the system will show suggestions from Yahoo Finance. Suggestions include the ticker, company name, exchange, and asset type.
symbolSearch.tip: Search supports Vietnamese stocks (HOSE, HNX), international stocks, ETFs, and cryptocurrency.

customInvestments.title: Custom Assets
customInvestments.description: For assets not traded on any market (real estate, private equity...), you can create a 'custom investment'. Select 'Custom' when adding an investment and enter the name and current value manually.
customInvestments.tip: You can update the price manually at any time using the 'Set Price' tab inside the investment detail modal.

transactionTypes.title: Investment Transaction Types
transactionTypes.description: Each investment supports three transaction types:

buy.title: Buy
buy.description: Records a purchase. The system creates a new 'lot' with the specified price and quantity, used for FIFO cost basis calculation.

sell.title: Sell
sell.description: Records a sale. The system applies FIFO to determine the cost basis of the units sold and calculates the realized profit or loss.

dividend.title: Dividend
dividend.description: Records a dividend received. Does not affect the quantity held but is counted toward total income.

transactionTypes.tip: Click on an investment, then select the 'Transactions' tab to view history and add new transactions.

fifoAccounting.title: FIFO Accounting (First-In, First-Out)
fifoAccounting.description: The system uses the FIFO method to calculate cost basis when you sell. This means units purchased first are treated as sold first.

example.title: Example
example.description: Suppose you buy 100 VCB shares at 85,000 VND, then buy 50 more at 90,000 VND. When you sell 80 shares, the system calculates the cost basis as 80 × 85,000 VND = 6,800,000 VND (taken from the first purchase lot per FIFO).

benefits: Calculates realized PNL precisely per lot.
Tracks remaining quantity and current average cost basis.

goldSilver.title: Gold & Silver Investments
goldSilver.description: congdongvang.com provides specialized support for gold and silver investments with automatic unit conversion.

goldVnd.title: Vietnamese Gold (VND)
goldVnd.description: Supports SJC gold varieties (SJL1L10, SJL1C, SJR2...). Quantities are stored in grams, but the interface displays values in tael (lượng / chỉ). 1 tael = 37.5 grams.

goldUsd.title: World Gold (USD)
goldUsd.description: Track XAU gold at international prices in USD per ounce. The system automatically updates prices from Yahoo Finance.

silverVnd.title: Silver (VND)
silverVnd.description: Similar to Vietnamese gold, domestic silver is tracked per tael with prices from domestic sources.

goldSilver.tip: When entering VND gold quantities, enter in tael (lượng). The system automatically converts to grams when saving.

priceAlerts.title: Price Alerts
priceAlerts.description: The price alerts feature notifies you when an asset's price reaches a threshold you define.

setup.title: Setting Up an Alert
steps: Go to Settings → Price Alerts.
Click 'Create New Alert'.
Select the asset to monitor.
Set the price threshold (above or below).
Activate the alert.

status.active: Active — the system is actively monitoring.
status.triggered: Triggered — the price has reached the threshold and a notification was sent.
status.paused: Paused — the alert is inactive until you reactivate it.

priceAlerts.tip: You can pause an alert without deleting it so you can reuse it later.

community.title: Community Forum
community.description: The Community page is where you share market insights, discuss investments, and connect with fellow investors.

creatingPosts.title: Creating Posts
creatingPosts.description: Share analysis, news, or investment experience with the community.
steps: Click the 'Create Post' button on the Community page.
Enter your post content (plain text supported).
Add hashtags to categorize your post (e.g. #gold, #stocks).
Click 'Post' to publish.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Use hashtags to categorize posts and help others find related content. Click a hashtag to filter all posts with that tag.

creatingPosts.tip: High-quality posts with specific analysis tend to receive more engagement from the community.

interactions.title: Community Interactions
interactions.description: Engage with the community in multiple ways:

commenting.title: Commenting
commenting.description: Click on a post to view details and leave a comment. Comments support plain text and are ordered chronologically.

liking.title: Liking Posts
liking.description: Click the heart icon to like a post. The like count is displayed publicly on each post.

following.title: Following Users
following.description: Click 'Follow' on a user's profile to follow investors you're interested in. Your feed will prioritize posts from people you follow.

savedPosts.title: Saving Posts
savedPosts.description: Click the bookmark icon to save important posts. View your saved posts from your profile page.

interactions.tip: Follow experienced investors to get notified when they publish new posts.

sentimentVoting.title: Market Sentiment Voting
sentimentVoting.description: The sentiment voting feature lets the community express their view on the direction of gold and silver prices.

howToVote.title: How to Vote
steps: On the Community page, find the 'Market Sentiment' section.
Select 'Bull' if you expect prices to rise.
Select 'Bear' if you expect prices to fall.
The community's aggregated vote results are displayed in real time.

sentimentVoting.interpretation: The vote distribution reflects the overall community sentiment — it is not investment advice. Always do your own research before making any decisions.
sentimentVoting.tip: Votes are periodically reset to reflect current market sentiment rather than long-term historical bias.
